## Checklist

* [ ] The change has one coherent purpose.
* [ ] Claims are no stronger than their supporting evidence.
* [ ] No secret, credential, private key, or sensitive evidence is included.
* [ ] Relevant failure paths were considered.
* [ ] Documentation reflects implementation status accurately.
* [ ] Tests or validation are proportional to the change.
* [ ] Commit history is reviewable and appropriately signed.
